Hi Maya / Liam —

Great to meet today — appreciated the candid overview of HelixCloud's latency-sensitive search feature and the constraints around audit logging and VPC peering. Quick recap and a proposed cadence to get to the technical deep dive + POC kickoff: 

- Goal: 60–90 minute technical deep dive with infra + security (we'll bring a runtime engineer and the private-deploy checklist).
- Ask from Helix: confirm preferred timezone windows for recurring deep dives so we can rotate slots fairly across teams in US / EU / APAC.
- Our proposal: a 3-week rotating wheel of slots (one per region) so your SREs and Product folks don't have to stay late every session. Details below.

Proposed rotating 'wheel' (all times shown in local zones — we'll send calendar invites in your zone):
  1) Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00–11:30 PT / Wed 13:00–14:30 CET / Wed 21:00–22:30 SGT
  2) Week B (EU-friendly): Tue 14:00–15:30 PT / Wed 17:00–18:30 CET / Thu 01:00–02:30 SGT
  3) Week C (APAC-friendly): Wed 08:00–09:30 PT / Wed 17:00–18:30 CET / Thu 01:00–02:30 SGT

If that wheel looks ok, we can schedule the first deep dive next Tuesday (Week A). I attached a mutual action plan (MAP-HelixCloud-v1.pdf) with milestones and who from each side should join.

Next steps:
- Maya/Liam: tell us which week in the next three you'd prefer to start, and any blackout dates.
- We'll create a rotating calendar series and share a Zoom link + HubSpot deal record.

Thanks again — I'll follow up with the calendar once I hear back.

Best,
